svg.title: Galaxy Tab S11 — silver
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. Portrait, 10 units/mm. Body 165.3 × 253.8 mm; centered display derived from 278.1 mm full-rectangle diagonal and 1600 × 2560 pixels. Original illustration: placement, corner radii, camera details and finish swatches are approximations. Sources: https://news.samsung.com/global/meet-samsung-galaxy-tab-s11-series-packing-everything-you-expect-from-a-premium-tablet; https://www.samsung.com/uk/tablets/galaxy-tab-s/galaxy-tab-s11-silver-128gb-wi-fi-sm-x730nzsreub/
